title: An Empirical Study of Recent Large Language Models for Knowledge Graph to Text Generation on Standard Benchmarks
abstract: arXiv:2610.31529v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Knowledge graph-to-text (KG-to-text) generation verbalizes a set of knowledge graph triples into fluent natural language. While fine-tuned encoder-decoder models have long been the standard approach, recent LLMs are becoming increasingly competitive. We benchmark recent LLMs against fine-tuned encoder-decoder models, using reference-based metrics and graph-grounded reference-free LLM-based evaluation validated against human annotations. We observed that recent LLMs substantially narrow, and in several settings close, the gap with fine-tuned models on reference-based metrics, while performing better on graph-grounded metrics. LLM-based evaluation scores show limited correlation with reference-based metrics, suggesting that the two approaches capture different aspects of generation quality. translated_title: 标准基准上最新大语言模型用于知识图谱到文本生成的实证研究
translated_abstract: 知识图谱到文本生成任务旨在将一组知识图谱三元组转化为流畅的自然语言。虽然微调的编码器-解码器模型长期以来一直是标准方法，但最近的大语言模型（LLM）正变得日益具有竞争力。我们在标准基准上将最新的LLM与微调的编码器-解码器模型进行对比测试，采用基于参考文本的指标以及经过人工标注验证的、基于图谱的无参考LLM评估方法。我们观察到，最新的LLM在基于参考的指标上大幅缩小了与微调模型的差距，并在若干设置下追平了这一差距，同时在基于图谱的指标上表现更佳。基于LLM的评估分数与基于参考的指标仅呈现有限的相关性，这表明两种方法捕捉的是生成质量的不同方面。基于图谱的评估显示，提示式模型比微调模型产生更少的矛盾和三元组遗漏，而这些错误会随之增加……（原文截断）
tldr: 该研究在标准基准上系统对比了最新大语言模型与微调编码器-解码器模型在知识图谱到文本生成任务中的表现，发现LLM在基于参考的指标上大幅缩小甚至在部分设置下追平了差距，且在基于图谱的评估中产生更少的矛盾和三元组遗漏。
en_tdlr: This empirical study benchmarks recent LLMs against fine-tuned encoder-decoder models for knowledge graph-to-text generation on standard benchmarks, finding that LLMs substantially narrow or close the gap on reference-based metrics while producing fewer contradictions and triple omissions in graph-grounded evaluation.
